aws_vpc.playbook: Recreate CIDR plan; site-to-site VPN/interconnect first, then peer with legacy.

aws_security_group.playbook: Export rules to neutral policy format; test deny-by-default.

aws_lb.playbook: Replicate listeners and health checks; weighted DNS cutover.

aws_iam_role.playbook: Inventory trust policies; map to neutral RBAC; replace instance-profile auth with workload identity.

aws_iam_policy.playbook: Translate JSON policies to target authz model; test with access-analyzer diffs.

aws_cognito_user_pool.playbook: Password hashes cannot be exported: use lazy-migration on first login or forced reset; plan comms.

aws_kms_key.playbook: Keys are non-exportable: re-encrypt every dataset under new keys; schedule rewrite windows.

aws_secretsmanager_secret.playbook: Export, rotate on arrival, update consumers.

aws_instance.target: Any IaaS VM or bare metal
aws_instance.playbook: Image export (OVA/QCOW2) or rebuild from IaC; cutover by DNS.

aws_eks_cluster.playbook: Replace IRSA/ALB-controller add-ons; GitOps re-point; run clusters in parallel.

aws_ecs_service.playbook: Translate task definitions to Deployments; swap service discovery.

aws_lambda_function.playbook: Repackage handlers as containers; re-implement event-source mappings.

aws_api_gateway_rest_api.playbook: Export OpenAPI; re-create authorizers, throttling, usage plans.

aws_sfn_state_machine.playbook: ASL has no standard equivalent: re-model workflows and re-test failure paths.

aws_db_instance.playbook: Logical replication to target; verify row counts and checksums; promote.

aws_rds_cluster.playbook: Aurora-specific features (fast clone, global DB) must be re-designed; use logical replication.

aws_dynamodb_table.playbook: Access patterns are the schema: re-model, dual-write via streams, backfill, verify, cut reads then writes.

aws_redshift_cluster.target: ClickHouse / Trino + Iceberg on object storage
aws_redshift_cluster.playbook: UNLOAD to Parquet, re-create distribution/sort keys, port stored procedures.

aws_s3_bucket.playbook: rclone/sync with checksums; replicate bucket policies and lifecycle rules; egress is the cost driver.

aws_elasticache_cluster.playbook: Warm cache or replica-sync; cache is rebuildable.

aws_sqs_queue.playbook: Dual-publish, drain legacy queue, flip consumers; handle DLQs and visibility timeouts.

aws_sns_topic.playbook: Re-create fan-out subscriptions; retest filtering policies.

aws_kinesis_stream.playbook: Mirror with a bridge consumer; rebase offsets; replay window planning.

aws_sagemaker_endpoint.playbook: Export model artifacts; rebuild serving image and autoscaling; re-validate drift and latency.

aws_glue_job.playbook: Rewrite DynamicFrame code to open Spark; replace Data Catalog with Hive/Iceberg catalog.

aws_cloudfront_distribution.playbook: Re-create behaviours and cache keys; lower TTLs then switch CNAME.

aws_route53_zone.playbook: Zone export; pre-lower TTLs; delegate NS at registrar.

aws_cloudwatch_log_group.playbook: Dual-ship logs; port metric filters and alarms.

azurerm_linux_virtual_machine.playbook: Export VHD or rebuild from IaC.

azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.playbook: Replace AAD pod identity/ingress add-ons; GitOps re-point.

azurerm_cosmosdb_account.playbook: Native SQL API is proprietary; re-model, change-feed dual-write, backfill.

azurerm_storage_account.playbook: Blob API differs from S3: adapt SDK calls; AzCopy/rclone with checksums.

azurerm_linux_function_app.playbook: Containerise functions; port bindings and triggers.

azurerm_key_vault.playbook: Keys non-exportable if HSM-backed: re-encrypt data.

azuread_application.playbook: Recreate app registrations, claims mapping, conditional-access equivalents.

azurerm_synapse_workspace.playbook: Export to Parquet; rewrite pipelines and T-SQL specifics.

azurerm_cognitive_account.playbook: Re-evaluate quality on open models; rebuild prompts and guardrails.

google_container_cluster.playbook: Replace Workload Identity/GCLB add-ons; GitOps re-point.

google_cloud_run_service.playbook: Cloud Run is Knative-compatible: redeploy manifests.

google_spanner_instance.playbook: TrueTime semantics differ; re-test transactions and latency.

google_bigtable_instance.playbook: HBase API compatible; export via Dataflow/Parquet.

google_bigquery_dataset.playbook: Export to Parquet; rewrite SQL dialect, slots and UDFs.

google_pubsub_topic.playbook: Bridge subscribers; handle ordering keys and dead letters.
